headline: H&M Prepares Store Expansions and Renovations in Peru for 2027
summary: Global fashion chain H&M reported a positive performance across its nearly 20 stores in Peru and announced plans for Plaza Norte in 2027 following recent store renovations.
why: Store network upgrades and expansions reflect retail footprint optimization in high-growth Latin American markets.

impacts.name: H&M
impacts.why: New store openings and facility renovations drive retail sales volume growth in the regional market.
